levels.name: Mittelbron / Skyttelbron
other_names: Norra övergången (Jernhusen; which of the two bridges it means is not stated)
levels.note: Two separate footbridges over all tracks, not one level: Mittelbron (built 1996, middle of the platforms) and Skyttelbron (opened 2014, further north). With Rydes undergång the platform area has three access points (sv Wikipedia).

Platforms and street. Station buildings at this level: Stationshuset (1850s, listed 1972, east, Bangatan 1), Västra stationsbyggnaden (glass, 2001, west, Västra Stationstorget) and Godsmagasinet (east, by Bangatan). No signposted level name found.

levels.name: Rydes undergång
levels.note: Popular name ("i folkmun") of the 1920s pedestrian tunnel at the south end, from the station building in the east to Västra stationsbyggnaden in the west. Jernhusen: open daily 05:00–00:00.

answers.question: platform 2: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Tracks 2 and 3 share one island platform (Trafikverket: platform "2,3", BIS 1022). Its stairs, escalators and lifts (Mittelbron, Skyttelbron, Rydes undergång) are tagged for 2–3 in OSM, so they serve track 2 too; the app should attach them to p2 as well as p3.
answers._source: Trafikverket, Järnvägsnätsbeskrivning Bilaga 2A tab 4 rows 545–548 and BanInfo BIS 1022/2097/1031/1060 (as compiled in /home/claude/work/out/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv), read 2026-10-30; OSM (osmfacts 740000120), read 2026-10-30

answers.question: platform 4: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Tracks 4 and 5 share one island platform (Trafikverket: platform "4,5", BIS 2097). Its stairs, escalators and lifts (Mittelbron, Skyttelbron, Rydes undergång) serve track 4 too; the app should attach them to p4 as well as p5.

open: Floor heights of the footbridges and Rydes undergång: no open source.
Which bridge Jernhusen calls "Norra övergången" (open 24 h): Skyttelbron is the northernmost, but Jernhusen does not name it.
Lift/stair positions rest on OSM only here; Skånetrafiken's terminal map (used for the app's map) shows them but its symbols are not machine-readable.

Hours for Pressbyrån, Viggo, Asian Express, Godsmagasinet, Stationshuset and Västra stationen: Jernhusen gives none and the shops' sites could not be read (robots or no store page); OSM hours exist for Pressbyrån and Asian Express only.
Skånetrafiken kundcenter hours: Jernhusen refers to Skånetrafiken's site, which did not list them in the text read.
